title: Annotatio III §.VIII close: Prayer for the Sacred Peace building; Royal Rescript to Bishop Ursinus introduced — stop before Rescript body
pass_a_gloss: This OUR MOST PIOUS KING — that, with the blessing of the MOST HIGH GOD of Peace, he may advance as happily as possible the building of Sacred Peace (whose Foundation he strove again last year to lay, using our slight labor for it most clemently) and bring it to the very Summit, other Kings and Princes also helping as tireless Promoters of kindly Ecclesiastical Peace, unto the Glory of GOD and the Comfort and Joy of all Evangelicals — is what we vow and pray from the heart. The Royal Rescript in this Business, given to his first Bishop, the Most Reverend Lord BENJAMIN URSINUS, and turned from German into Latin, we judge should be communicated to our Reader in this place, so that it may be free for anyone to judge of the most sincere Intention of OUR AUGUST KING, and of His most fervent zeal for promoting Ecclesiastical Peace.
pass_b_english: This is what we vow and pray from the heart for our Most Pious King:

that, with the Most High God of Peace blessing him, he may carry the building of Sacred Peace as happily as possible to its very summit — last year he again strove to lay its foundation, most kindly using our slight labor —
other kings and princes also helping as tireless promoters of kindly church peace, for God’s glory and the comfort and joy of all Evangelicals.
We judge the Royal Rescript in this business — given to his first bishop, the Most Reverend Lord Benjamin Ursinus, and turned from German into Latin — should be set before our reader here,
so anyone may judge the most sincere intention of our August King and his most fervent zeal to promote ecclesiastical peace.
Stop before the Rescript body (Nos Dei Gratia Fridericus Rex Borussiae…).
source_text: Hic REX NOSTER PIENTISSIMUS, ut aedificium Pacis Sacrae, (cujus Fundamentum praeteritô annô denuò jacere molitus est, exilique opellâ nostrâ, ad id quam clementissimè usus) benedicente Pacis DEO O. M. quàm felicissimè provehat, adque ipsum Fastigium, succurrentibus etiam aliis Regibus Principibusque, Almae Pacis Ecclesiasticae Promotoribus indefessis, in DEI Gloriam & Evangelicorum omnium Solatium Gaudiumque perducat, est, quod animitus vovemus precamurque. Rescriptum in hoc Negotio Regium, ad Episcopum suum primum, Reverendissimum Dominum BENJAMIN URSINUM, datum, & ex Germanico in Latinum versum, Lectori nostro hôc locô communicandum ducimus, quò de sincerissima AUGUSTI REGIS NOSTRI Intentione, deque Ejus studio, Pacem Ecclesiasticam promovendi fervidissimo, judicare cuivis integrum sit.
notes: Prayer + Rescript intro to Ursinus; stop before Rescript body.
